thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — spike in 5xx errors from inference-edge in eu-west-1. Alert: infra.http.5xx_rate > 5% for 2m. Correlation: increased p95 latency for text-gen routes. Link: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/infra-http-5xx

maria: I'm on it. Can someone pull the recent rollout and traffic shifts? Any canary going out to eu-west-1?

raj: No canary today AFAIK. Last deploy was a runtime patch at 1709500000 (yesterday). Checking logs now.

sophie: I see repeated KV cache misses and a surge in `model.kv_cache_load` failures in logs from eu-west-1. Could be a kernel mismatch after quantization adjustment. Dumping sample traces.

ops-bot: Autoscaler: 6 new GPU nodes added to eu-west-1 pool in last 3m (scaleup triggered).

maria: Good, thanks. If autoscaling triggered we might be hitting cold-cache penalties and overload on the runtime process. Raj, can you tail the runtime logs and grep for `kv_cache` and `segfault`?

raj: Running: ```bash
kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=10m | egrep "kv_cache|segfault|OOM|traceback" | tail -n 200
```

raj: Found repeated stack traces: `KeyError: missing shard-23` and intermittent `RuntimeError: cache desync` from runtime-1/2/3. Also a couple of OOM-killed pods ~ 2m ago.

leo: OOMs explain p95 spikes. Looks like the recent quantize profile increased memory pressure on sequence lengths > 1024. On old nodes the kernel fallback worked, on new nodes it fails to allocate.

maria: Ok immediate mitigation: reduce per-request max_tokens on affected route, and shift some traffic to us-central as a fallback. Can we put a temporary router policy to divert 30% of eu-west traffic to us-central and throttle requests > 1k tokens?

raj: I'll push a routing override: ```PATCH /v1/routing/policies/active
{"region_overrides": {"eu-west-1": {"fallback_regions": ["us-central-1"], "fallback_share": 0.3}}}
``` Applying now...

ops-bot: Route override applied. eu-west-1 -> 30% to us-central-1.

maria: Also update the rate limiter: set per-route max_tokens to 1000 for `text-gen` routes in eu-west-1. Raj, Sophie, confirm?

sophie: Agreed. I'll submit a quick rule to the API gateway. ```rule add gen-eu-token-cap -> if region==eu-west-1 and route==text-gen then max_tokens=1000```

incident-bot: Note: customer-impact assessment in progress. Affected customers: ~8 percent of active sessions in eu-west-1 seeing elevated 5xx. ETA for mitigation: 10-15 mins.

samir: FYI CS: We're seeing two enterprise customers opening support tickets claiming degraded latency in EU. They're happy to be routed to us-central temporarily if needed. I'll inform them of the mitigation.

leo: Patching runtime memory flags to prefer fallback allocator on new instances. Rolling restart of 4 nodes with `--allocator=jemalloc-safe`. Doing canary restart on runtime-1 now.

ops-bot: runtime-1 restarted (canary). Post-restart KV errors dropped for that instance.

raj: After route override + throttles and restart, overall 5xx rate decreased from 6.8% -> 1.2% in 7m. p95 latency down by 40%.

maria: Nice. Keep the fallback in place for now. We'll do a controlled lift after stability. I'm going to start an incident timeline doc.

sophie: We should treat this as both a capacity and a tuning regression: quantization profile caused memory growth for long sequences, which manifests as OOM and cache desyncs under scale.

monitoring-bot: New dashboard panel created: "regional-kv-cache-errors" on infra-regional-health. Link: https://grafana.redwood/d/infra-regional-health

maria: Action items during incident: 1) Keep route override 30% until post-incident review. 2) Roll new runtime flags cluster-wide. 3) Open issue for quantize profile rollback/analysis. 4) Adjust alerting to reduce noise. Assignments?

raj: I'll own the rollout of runtime flags (#2) and open the issue (#3).

sophie: I'll lead the alert tuning (#4) and make a dashboard that correlates kv_cache misses, OOMs, and p95 latency by region.

samir: I'll send customer comms and update two affected enterprise tickets; mark them routed to us-central.

incident-bot: Handoff: on-call shift at 20:00 UTC. Current owner: maria -> handing to leo in 10m.

leo: Taking handoff. Summary for next on-call: routing override active, per-route token cap in eu-west-1, runtime flag roll ongoing (4/12 nodes done), watch kv_cache_errors, OOM events, and p95. Pager threshold lowered during spike — revert only after 30m stable.

maria: Leaving note: postmortem required. Initial impact window ~ 1719504100 - 1719504700. Customer-visible errors ~8% active sessions. Root cause hypothesis posted to incident doc.

sophie: Quick follow-up on alert tuning: current infra.http.5xx_rate alert threshold at 5% is fine, but it fires too often for small traffic clusters. I'll split it into composite alerts:
- infra.http.5xx_rate.high_global (>4% across >2 regions)
- infra.http.5xx_rate.regional (>5% in a region with >1000 qps)
- infra.http.5xx_noise.low_traffic (>10% but from <100 qps -> warn only)
Also adding a 1m->2m smoothing window to avoid flapping.

maria: Good call. Also add a synthetic canary that runs a 512-token generation every 30s per region to detect runtime regressions earlier.

monitoring-bot: New alert created: `infra.kv_cache_errors.regional` with severity=warning, runbook=https://wiki.redwood/ops/runbooks/kv-cache-errors. Link: https://alerts.redwood/infra-kv-cache-errors

leo: For failover monitors: I added a new Grafana panel for multi-region traffic shift showing routing override percentages and cross-region latency. Also created an alert: `routing.fallback.rate` if fallback_share > 0.25 for >5m.

raj: Opened ticket INF-5421: "Investigate quantize memory regression & create reproducible test for seq_len>1024". Assigned to eng-ml and eng-runtime. Priority P1 due to customer impact.

samir: CS notes: Two enterprise customers given temporary route change; they accepted. No SLA credits requested yet but they asked for RCA. Will request postmortem link once available.

maria: Post-incident checklist before close: - Confirm global 5xx rate < 1% for 30m - Complete runtime flags roll - Decision on quantize profile rollback or adjust profile - Update runbook and alerts - Schedule retro with eng-ml + runtime.

monitoring-bot: System note: stability window started at 1719504680. Current stable duration: 7m 10s.

leo: Rolling runtime flags to remaining nodes now. Will watch memory + KV metrics.

sophie: Created dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/infra-eu-health with panels: p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv_cache_errors, OOM count, route_override_pct. Sharing with eng-ml and infra.

maria: Thanks team. I'll file the postmortem and include these follow-ups. Leaving channel; handoff complete. :white_check_mark:

leo: Copy. I'll keep monitoring overnight and escalate if anything changes.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation successful, follow-ups assigned. Closing incident thread.
